highlights: 4 miles per dollar on dining, petrol and retail and 0.4 mpd for other local and FCY spend.
pros: Earn 10X TREATS Points (4 miles) per S$1 spent at specially selected retail stores, restaurants, and all petrol stations islandwide+.
pros: Get up to 20.05% savings on petrol.
pros: Complimentary green fees at world-class golf fairways.
pros: Complimentary enrolment into Rewards Infinite Programme: TREATS Points never expire.
pros: Complimentary Plaza Premium airport lounge access with a minimum charge of S$1,000 in a single retail transaction.
pros: Complimentary travel insurance coverage of up to S$1,000,000 when air tickets/travel packages are charged in full to the card.
cons: TREATS Points awarded calculated based on blocks of S$5.
cons: Annual fee: S$240 (waived for first year only)

extra.description: Enjoy golfing and travel benefits with the Maybank World MasterCard. With this card, you'll enjoy 4 miles per dollar on select merchants, with complimentary green fees all year round at 100 participating golf clubs.
